Medvedev disqualified after hitting fan, Djokovic advances to China Open final

Russian tennis player Daniil Medvedev was disqualified from the China Open after hitting a spectator in the face with a ball. The incident occurred during his match against Novak Djokovic, who subsequently advanced to the final. Medvedev issued an apology following the disqualification.
